## Problem

Surfaced while fixing `anatomical-arbored-oyster` (e3e0-2e7c-b280-4b4a). With the mirror sweep's collection/install errors removed, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_main.py` now runs and fails on the non-editable macOS and floor legs:

```
AssertionError: Resolved repo_root PosixPath('/Users/runner/work/rebar/rebar/.venv/lib/python3.13')
does not contain src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py — default root resolution is wrong;
expected Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] from __main__.py
```

## Root cause

The reconciler's `main()` default repo-root fallback (in `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py`, when `--repo-root`/`REBAR_ROOT` are absent) derives the root as `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]`. Under an **editable** install `__file__` is `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py`, so `parents[4]` is the repo root. Under a **non-editable** install `__file__` is `<venv>/lib/pythonX/site-packages/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py`, so `parents[4]` is `<venv>/lib/pythonX` — not a checkout. `test_reconcile_main.py::_assert_resolved_repo_root` asserts the resolved default contains `src/rebar/...`, which cannot hold once installed.

Unlike the release-packaging tests fixed under the parent ticket (test-side path derivation), this is a **production** behavior: the reconciler's default repo-root under a non-editable install is a checkout path that does not exist.

## Fix direction (BEHAVIOR — needs decision)

Decide what the reconciler's default repo root should be when installed non-editably (e.g. require `--repo-root`/`REBAR_ROOT`, fall back to CWD, or error clearly), and update `_default_repo_root()` and its test accordingly. Behavior-altering -> design decision.

## Evidence
- Mirror run 33299427686: `sweep (macos, full suite)` job 99224621948 (4x), `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` job 99224621821 (6x).
- Also failing in the pre-fix run 33285143350 macOS leg (pre-existing, was masked by the collection error).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `test_reconcile_main.py` repo-root resolution assertions pass under both editable and non-editable installs.
- [ ] The reconciler's default repo-root behavior under a non-editable install is defined and documented (no silent resolution into the venv tree).
compiled_state.title: Reconciler default repo-root fallback (__main__.py parents[4]) assumes an editable checkout; wrong under non-editable install
